name: Confirmation
overview: Confirmation in Scripture is grounded in the assurance of God's presence and faithfulness, encouraging believers to be strong and courageous as He is with them wherever they go (Joshua 1:9). Trusting in God brings stability and support, as He sustains the righteous and shields those who rely on His pure word (Psalms 55:22; Proverbs 30:5). Believers are called to seek God's kingdom and righteousness first, with the promise that their needs will be met and that prayer offered in faith will be answered (Matthew 6:33; 21:22). Ultimately, confirmation rests on the foundational truth of God's love demonstrated through Christ, granting eternal life to all who believe (John 3:16).
